review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues. Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments. Requirements 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure. Advanced, hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama) — including firewall, endpoint policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
